copy_policy: Exact source bytes with SHA-256; snapshot_pa6 is independent of the frozen PE snapshot.
scope: 2026-10-30 single ordered PA6 candidate pilot and diagnosis; no full v1.2 library, D1/D14, DFT, periodic convergence or hydrogen-bond network acceptance has been completed.
excluded: Literature PDFs and paper atomic coordinates
Binary trajectories, optimizer restart, log and process-monitor files
limitations: Historical absolute paths and links remain unchanged in byte-preserved sources; use docs/PA6_PROGRESS_20261031.md as the repository entry point.
This is a curated diagnostic archive, not an independently rerun PA6 workflow release.
Geometric phase scans and small directional probes do not establish barriers, dynamical stability or energy ordering.
